rawNbtBinding.scope: Compare two complete snapshots of the same actor on the same engine; preserve tag types, list element types/order, exact float bits, arrays and Modified UTF-8 bytes; compound key order alone is unordered. Retain both original SNBT strings. No cross-engine full NBT semantic equivalence.

attributeInputs.comparison: Exact binary64 initial values; any nonzero representation tolerance is reported separately and never makes exact equality true

sourceBasis.original: Fixed EntityMaid.createAttributes, LivingEntity.createLivingAttributes and Attributes; AttributeMap instance/supplier lookup and AttributeInstance modifier/value methods
sourceBasis.port: EntityMaid.applyEntityAttributes, EntityLivingBase.applyEntityAttributes, EntityLiving.applyEntityAttributes and SharedMonsterAttributes; BaseAttributeMap and ModifiableAttributeInstance getters
sourceBasis.modifierOperations: 0 addition; 1 multiply the base after additions; 2 multiply the running total
sourceBasis.bounds: Only the captured initial base/value/modifiers are compared; range/clamp behavior over other values is not claimed equivalent

attributeInputs.unmappedPolicy: Keep complete raw entity/attribute NBT and all actual attribute names; unknown or one-sided mappings remain NOT_PROVEN
attributeInputs.scope: Five source-backed actual initial attribute inputs only; not full NBT, environment, RNG, physics or complete B10 equivalence

ownerInputScope: controlled native registered players with isolated memory connections; not real network login or multiple real clients

enclosure.placement: four walls at x/z boundary from y1 through roof, full roof at height-1; original stone y0 remains
enclosure.scope: controlled closed arena prevents unowned gravity blocks and fluid entry; sides and roof are real collision/vision inputs

mechanisms.scope: Natural low-air escape onto a fixed dry bank and normal complete-root activity recovery; pool water is never withdrawn
Initial native glass roof blocks the pool surface; four roof cells open at actual START40, without moving the maid or resetting AI cadence

campaign.failurePolicy: Retain setup/measurement fault, death, timeout, partial capture, resource violation and untriggered behaviors. A collected episode is not a passed behavior; do not retry under the same sample id.

clockScope.sample: Native END observations and real START input changes only; full root factories, natural RNG and clocks.
clockScope.limits: No performance, real-network owner, statistical noninferiority or completeB09/B10/14-class admission.

primary: native air>=290 latency and breathing-plan clear
alive/registered at window end or actual death censor
actual net health loss and native damage callbacks
recovery: physical owner arrival within existing2-block criterion after recovery; task-cause not fabricated
airMetrics.sourceDifferences: Native air refill/eye-fluid/medium rules are recorded; source1.20 increases air by4, baseline1.7 resets300 outside water. Actual runtime frame values govern; no refill-time AI benefit is inferred.
airMetrics.deathDenominator: Actual death callback plus native terminal state ends the episode without padded frames; business success remains false. Any other registration/runtime/input failure remains a collection failure.
